Overview

El Alto is a city in LP with a population of 1,200,000. One of the fastest-growing cities in Bolivia, a high-altitude urban center overlooking La Paz with a strong Aymara cultural identity. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.0.
